## About
Advantage Autoworks is the work of brothers Todd and Chris Recker, who share a love for cool old cars and the know-how to take a new car that's been smashed up and bring it back to life.
Chris started out working solo, restoring Mustangs and Camaros while juggling college and a full time job. His early projects went on tour across the country and earned the highest gold class SHELBY awards. Word got around, Todd came on board, and the shop grew from there. Our restoration work has shown at car shows near and far and has been featured in magazines and books.
Alongside the classics, we handle late model foreign and domestic collision repair on just about anything on the road, from your average grocery getter to late model Ferraris. We're locally owned and operated on Davis Blvd in North Richland Hills, serving Dallas and Ft. Worth.

## Services
- Collision repair: Late model foreign and domestic collision repair, from fender benders and dents to bumpers and safety feature issues after an accident.
- Classic car restoration: Restoration of classic cars, from the popular models of the past to the cars now being brought back to life.
- Free computerized estimates: A reliable initial quote on visible damage and a timeline for the repair. Call to schedule or stop by during business hours.
- Rental car assistance: We can arrange to have an Enterprise rental ready for you at a nearby location while your car is being repaired.
- Towing: Get in touch and we'll set up towing and schedule your repair.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We're a Direct Repair partner with most insurance companies, which lets us go to work on your car without waiting around. We're also happy to walk you through how the insurance process works.

Q: Are your estimates free?
A: Yes. Give us a call to set up an appointment for a free estimate, or just stop by during business hours.

Q: Can you help me get a rental car?
A: Yes. We work with Enterprise and can have a rental ready for you at a nearby Enterprise location while we fix your car.

Q: My car can't be driven. Can you tow it?
A: Contact us and we'll arrange towing and schedule the repair. If you'd rather call a tow company yourself, we can point you to local ones we recommend.

When we showed up at Caliber Collision, they found out that the car had a rebuilt title and it was against their policy to work on a car with a rebuilt title. Ugh. We were leaving the following day on a road 10 day vacay and I’d planned to drop it off before we left. I was quickly looked up body shops in my area and sorted by ratings and distance. Advantage Autoworks came up at the top so I called. They’d be happy to work on the car. Yay! ‘We can get you in tomorrow…’ I admit it was last minute, but I explained my situation and he got me in right then. Thank you!! Drove to their shop and met with Cameron who was great to work with. I felt like I was leaving the car in great hands and Cameron said he’d provide updates along the way.
There were a few delays. A supplement for additional funds was submitted to my insurance company and they took their sweet time in approving it, but they finally did. Then there was a delay in receiving a new hood. Once received, the car was reassembled, painted and currently curing. But during QC (quality control) review, they realized they received the wrong hood. Our hood had a center scoop and the new hood did not. I hated the idea of the car being almost ready to go, all the work done by the shop, and realize it’s the wrong hood. So Cameron went out and snapped a picture of the new hood and I found a picture of the original hood. Then we checked to see if the center scoop served a purpose. For example, did it allow air into the engine to keep it cool or something. While Cameron went out to find the old hood, I searched for our car and year on the internet and found many without the scoop. And while it was cute, it was barely noticeable without it. So as long as it didn’t serve a purpose, I was happy to keep the new hood - which I did because the quick investigation by Cameron proved it did not. It was purely ornamental. Anyway, all this to say, the communication was awesome, even with us being thousands of miles away. And most importantly, the car looks amazing! I will definitely do business with them again, though hoping I don’t have to! 😉" (Shannon Neal, 5/5)
